explanation: Choice D is correct. Distributing the negative sign to the terms in the second parentheses yields $8w^{3} - 4w + 5 - 9w^{2} - 3w - (-1)$, or $8w^{3} - 4w + 5 - 9w^{2} - 3w + 1$. Grouping like terms in this expression yields $8w^{3} - 9w^{2} + (-4w - 3w) + (5 + 1)$. Combining like terms yields $8w^{3} - 9w^{2} - 7w + 6$.
